title: Meeting with representatives of the Congress of Women of the Kyrgyz Republic at BSU

blocks.text: On May 21, 2025, BSU Rector Mirlan Dyldaev held a meeting with the President of the Women's Congress of the Kyrgyz Republic, Secretary General of the Union of Business Incubators and Innovation Centers of the Kyrgyz Republic Zamira Akbagysheva and Vice President of the Congress Mira Rysalieva.

During the conversation, issues of cooperation in the field of education, support for women in science and entrepreneurship were discussed. The parties expressed their readiness to work together to implement educational and social initiatives.
